name: WP Rocket
couldBuild: Page cache, minification, lazy-loading, preloading. All documented technique.
stillMissing: The reason people pay is that it does not break checkout. Those exclusion rules are years of bug reports, and RocketCDN is a rented service.
requirements: Page cache with correct bypass for cart, checkout, account and logged-in users
CSS/JS minification and combination with a safe exclusion list
Lazy-loading for images and iframes, with LCP image excluded
Automatic purge on content, menu and product changes
